name: budgetcents
description: BudgetCents — personal and household finance for web and Android

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w @budgetcents/api" "npm run dev -w @budgetcents/web"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @budgetcents/domain && npm run test -w @budgetcents/api && npm run test -w @budgetcents/web
scripts.build: npm run build -w @budgetcents/domain && npm run build -w @budgetcents/web && npm run typecheck -w @budgetcents/api
